finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0). Root cause was two call sites that hadn't been updated for the bumped bundler's new options shape:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` explicitly and threw on anything else.

Everything else in the log (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267, the tree-shaking notes, dedupe lines) is just noisy but harmless deprecation chatter from the bump — unrelated to the failure and still present (8 warnings), but no longer fatal.
